Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect The tooth fairy attempts to pull out a tooth from a creature sharing a space with it. The target attempts a Fortitude save against the spell DC or class DC of the familiar’s master (whichever is higher).

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[1d4[bleed]] persistent bleed damage. The damage increases to @Damage[2d4[bleed]] at 12th level and @Damage[3d4[bleed]] at 18th level.

Critical Failure As failure, plus the tooth fairy pulls out one of the target’s teeth. If the creature loses a tooth, it takes a –1 status penalty to Charisma-based skill checks and must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] to Cast a Spell or the spell is disrupted. Spells with the subtle trait automatically succeed at this flat check. These effects last for 1 day, or until the stolen tooth is returned and the target regains at least 1 Hit Point.
